title: Moburst Skill frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter of every plugin/skills/<slug>/SKILL.md file.

name.description: kebab-case identifier; must match the skill folder name.

description.description: Trigger-oriented summary ('Use when ...'). This is how agents select the skill.

targets.description: Which agent platforms this skill supports.

version.description: Semantic version. Must increase on every edit — MobPulse's write path rejects a reused or lower version, because two revisions sharing a version are indistinguishable in analytics, retroactively.

runtime.description: Where the skill runs: 'hosted' = Anthropic cloud sandbox (claude.ai / Claude Desktop, /mnt/skills paths); 'local' = runs anywhere (Claude Code CLI, Codex).

status.description: Lifecycle state. 'deprecated' still installs and reads normally, but MobPulse shows a Deprecated badge on the skill card.
